Fetch price details for multiple drop-off shipments in a single request. Each shipment in the array follows the same validation rules as the single /dropOff/price endpoint. Returns an array of price calculations for each shipment.

Uses the legacy nested capture payload. Waybill is optional: supplied waybills are preserved; otherwise a waybill is generated with the SH prefix using service centre 491. Sender station is fixed at 4 and departure service centre at 491. Shipment and item prices are fixed at 1; no wallet validation, debit or payment is performed. When ShipmentDetails.CashOnDeliveryAmount is greater than zero, COD is enabled, a CashOnDeliveryRegisterAccount is created in SQL and MongoDB, and preshipment COD status is marked as initiated. Reference lookups are cached in Redis for five minutes with database fallback. Writes PreShipmentMobile, PreShipmentItemMobile, Shipment, ShipmentItem, MobileShipmentTracking and DeliveryNumber in SQL and MongoDB, plus the COD register when applicable. The legacy /capture/preshiment/shein route is also supported.
